Position Summary

Indiana University Bloomington invites applications for an Elmus
Wicker Chair position at the rank of associate or full professor in
the Department of Economics.

The 10-month appointment would ideally start August 1, 2027; an
earlier or later start date is negotiable.

We especially encourage candidates in Macroeconomics, Applied
Microeconomics, Experimental Economics, Econometrics, and
International Economics.

Before a conditional offer of employment with tenure is finalized,
candidates will be asked to disclose any pending investigations or
previous findings of sexual or professional misconduct. They will
also be required to authorize an inquiry by Indiana University
Bloomington with all current and former employers along these
lines. The relevance of information disclosed or ascertained in the
context of this process to a candidate’s eligibility for hire will
be evaluated by Indiana University Bloomington on a case-by-case
basis. Applicants should be aware, however, that Indiana University
Bloomington takes the matters of sexual and professional misconduct
very seriously.

Indiana University is an equal opportunity employer and provider of
ADA services and prohibits discrimination in hiring. See Indiana
University Notice of Non-Discrimination here which includes contact
information.
https://policies.iu.edu/policies/ua-01-non-discrimination/index.html


Basic Qualifications

Candidates must have a Ph.D., established research leadership, and
the capacity for high-quality undergraduate and graduate
teaching.

Department Contact for Questions

Questions: Erin Kirchhofer, (812) 855-2990, econadmn@indiana.edu
.

Salary and Rank

submit:

· Current CV
· Research sample
· Contact information for references (six references will be
solicited from finalists)
